messages:
sanjay.k: Quick item — SI mentor rotation + local HW voucher flow. We're getting repeated questions from EMEA partners about how mentors pick up shifts and how vouchers map to regional HW drops. Can we align ops + enablement?
lina_p: yep, seen that. Main pain: mentors aren't in the same timezone and voucher redemption instructions reference US-only SKUs. leads to follow-ups and delays.
matt_reed: Suggestion: create a short 'mentor shift' checklist + a localized voucher FAQ per region. Keep it 1 page.
olivia: Also need an interop/compatibility checklist for partner labs — some SI partners are shipping GPUs with slightly different drivers, and our lab exercise images fail.
ashley_ops: that happened last week with a partner in DE. We shipped table of supported driver versions but they had a custom kernel. We should add a pre-flight checklist for SI HW receipts.
sanjay.k: OK concrete asks:
1) Mentor rotation template (who covers, overlap handoff, primary contact)
2) Voucher flow doc (redeem windows, SKU mapping, regional notes)
3) SI lab interop checklist (drivers, OS images, firewall rules)
4) Quick troubleshooting play for mentor to escalate to support
Can volunteers own each piece?
lina_p: I can draft mentor rotation template + handoff script. Will base on last quarter's rota.
matt_reed: I'll take voucher flow. Will include sample redeem email and API snippet for marketplace vouchers.
olivia: I'll own interop checklist and a small validation script for driver checks.
si-onboard-bot: New task created: #TI-4823 "SI Mentor Rotation Template" assigned to lina_p, due 2024-04-05.
ashley_ops: matt — for voucher flow, please call out carrier/warranty differences for hardware shipped through marketplace vs direct vendor voucher. That tripped us in APAC.
matt_reed: good call. also thinking a 2-line copy for mentors they can paste into Slack to confirm voucher claims. Example:
```
Hi @partner-team, please confirm HW voucher code CLAIM-XXXX is redeemed by 2024-05-10. If there are any shipping restrictions, reply here and tag @ashley_ops.
```
lina_p: love the copy. for mentor rotation template, I'm going to include a 1-week overlap window and a 'shift log' snippet. sample shift log:
```
Shift date: 2024-04-10
Mentor on duty: Lina P
Handover notes: verified voucher redemptions x3, started lab prep image 1.2 -> found kernel mismatch on node 2
Escalations: opened ticket #S-998
```
olivia: for interop checklist, list will include: kernel version, CUDA/cuDNN, NIC firmware, MTU settings, iptables/nft rules, and a smoke test (run quick minimal inference with model X). I'll add a tiny bash script to verify CUDA + driver versions.
matt_reed: can you paste the script in the voucher doc as well? mentors could run it before labs.
olivia: yep. snippet:
```
#!/bin/bash
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,cuda_version --format=csv && 
python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"
```
ashley_ops: timeline? We need these docs before the next SI cohort in mid-May. Can we have drafts by end of next week?
lina_p: I can do mentor template by Fri 04/05.
matt_reed: voucher flow draft by Fri 04/05 as well.
olivia: interop checklist draft by Mon 04/08 (need to run a couple more lab repros).
sanjay.k: perfect. escalation flow: add support routing matrix (oncall -> partner success -> eng-runtime) and include expected SLAs for hardware-critical issues.
ashley_ops: I'll add the routing matrix after matt and olivia's drafts — mostly a mapping table: issue type -> primary -> backup -> notify channel.
lina_p: one more: certification gate question. Should mentors be certified? some partners ask for mentor badges for clients.
matt_reed: yes a light 'mentor badge' makes sense: 2-hour training + exam + proctored checklist. we can tie it to access to production voucher pool.
olivia: recommend adding a short practical assessment (can they debug a failed node) rather than multiple choice only.
sanjay.k: agreed. add 'proctored practical' as gate. matt add certification flow to voucher doc (access rules for voucher pool).
si-onboard-bot: New task created: #TI-4828 "SI Lab Interop Checklist" assigned to olivia, due 2024-04-08.
ashley_ops: tiny admin ask — can we get a single shared spreadsheet where mentor shifts and voucher redemptions are logged? avoids overlapping claims.
lina_p: I'll make a Google Sheet and add edit perms for mentor leads + ashley_ops. will include read-only export for partners.
matt_reed: I'll wire the voucher redemption API to append a row automatically when a voucher is redeemed from the marketplace (we have a webhook).
olivia: can we add a checkbox in the sheet for 'interop validated' so mentors can tick after running the script?
lina_p: yes.
sanjay.k: Great progress. Summary of owners and due dates:
- Mentor rotation template: lina_p, 2024-04-05
- Voucher flow + certification access rules: matt_reed, 2024-04-05
- SI lab interop checklist + script: olivia, 2024-04-08
- Escalation/routing matrix & sheet setup: ashley_ops, 2024-04-09
Can everyone confirm? If yes I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue to review drafts.
lina_p: confirmed :thumbsup:
matt_reed: confirmed :thumbsup:
olivia: confirmed :+1:
si-onboard-bot: Meeting created: SI enablement review — 2024-04-09 14:00 UTC. Invite sent.
ashley_ops: awesome. I'll start drafting the routing matrix tonight and paste into the sheet when ready.
sanjay.k: thanks team — let's keep replies in this thread for updates. If you hit blockers DM me.
matt_reed: FYI linking internal reference: https://redwood.internal/si/resources/voucher-guidance (will add more)
lina_p: adding template link: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/mentor-rotation-template (will share)
ashley_ops: note for postmortem: log any voucher mishandles and the corrective action. helps with vendor ops.
sanjay.k: noted. end of thread."
